title: gmaio comparison-reads samplesheet
description: One row per external comparison sample. These reads are QC'd/host-removed the same way as regular samples, then mapped against the final dereplicated bin representatives and the gene catalogue for comparison purposes -- they are never assembled or binned. Sample IDs must not collide with the main samplesheet's sample IDs.

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and contain no spaces

fastq_1.errorMessage: fastq_1 must be a path to a gzipped FASTQ (.fastq.gz / .fq.gz)

fastq_2.errorMessage: fastq_2 must be a path to a gzipped FASTQ (.fastq.gz / .fq.gz)
